# Lists

Plain bullets:

- First item
- Second item with a longer line of text that is long enough to wrap onto a second line when the window is narrow
- Third item
  - Nested item one
  - Nested item two
    - Third level
      - Fourth level

Ordered:

1. One
2. Two
   1. Two point one
   2. Two point two
3. Three with a long line of text that is long enough to wrap onto a second line when the window is narrow

Ten or more items change the number width:

8. Eight
9. Nine
10. Ten
11. Eleven

Tasks:

- [ ] An open task
- [x] A done task
- [ ] An open task with `inline code` and a [link](https://example.org/) in it
  - [x] A nested done task
  - [ ] A nested open task

Loose list:

- Paragraph one of the item.

  Paragraph two of the same item.

- A second item.

  ```go
  fmt.Println("code inside a list item")
  ```

- A third item with a quote:

  > Quoted text inside a list item.

Mixed:

1. Ordered
   - bullet inside ordered
   - another bullet
2. Ordered again
   1. ordered inside ordered
